<p>After entering the forest, Nerus and I moved at a rapid pace.</p><p>The forest was in ruins, with monster corpses strewn everywhere.</p><p>Fortunately, there were no human bodies in sight, so it seemed no Hunters had died here.</p><p>True to its S-rank Gate status, treasure chests were scattered openly throughout the forest.</p><p>They were sure to be filled with uniquely priced artifacts and rare materials.</p><p>After sprinting through the forest for about two hours, Nerus spoke up.</p><p>“Seong-hyeon-gong, there’s a door over there.”</p><p>“Huh?”</p><p>As we approached, there it was—a door.</p><p>It was unmistakably the entrance to the boss’s chamber.</p><p>“Passing through this door will take you to another location. The boss monster must be there.”</p><p>“Yes, since Nerus-nim can’t reveal yourself, I’ll fight it.”</p><p>“Protecting Seong-hyeon-gong is also my duty. If I judge that you’re in danger, I will step in.”</p><p>“Understood. I’ll leave it to you.”</p><p>After taking a few deep breaths, I opened the door and stepped inside.</p><p>Just like the doors Nerus summoned, the other side radiated an ominous energy.</p><p>***</p><p>“Everyone, stay sharp! Defense team, get those shields up now!”</p><p>“Yes!”</p><p>“Don’t give up yet! Reinforcements are coming soon! Keep your guard up!”</p><p>“Move the wounded to the back!”</p><p>The moment I passed through the door, the fierce sounds of battle reached my ears.</p><p>I glanced at Nerus, who was floating in midair and nodded at me.</p><p>The building had an almost cathedral-like atmosphere, constructed from grand stonework with a ceiling so high it seemed endless.</p><p>As I climbed the stairs toward the source of the noise, I found over 70 Hunters barely holding their ground against the boss.</p><p>“Phew…”</p><p>Thankfully, they looked exhausted, but Hye-na was still alive.</p><p>There were dead Hunters among them, mostly B-rank, but the two S-rank Hunters were still standing.</p><p>The boss was a typical monster-type, resembling a dragon with seven heads.</p><p>Flames erupted from each of the seven heads.</p><p>The Hunters were clinging on desperately, but they looked like they were about to collapse at any moment.</p><p>It seemed even stronger than the boss from the Gate where I’d obtained my gauntlet.</p><p>A wounded Hunter, who had been pulled back and was lying on the ground, heard my footsteps and turned to look. Our eyes met.</p><p>His face lit up with shock as he shouted,</p><p>“Vice President! The Vice President is here!”</p><p>Every Hunter’s gaze snapped toward me.</p><p>I shouted at them.</p><p>“What are you doing?! Don’t look back! Focus on defense!”</p><p>I approached the boss monster with gauntlets equipped on both hands, and it stopped attacking, staring at me with all seven of its heads.</p><p>Time seemed to freeze as only the boss and I faced each other.</p><p>“Everyone, fall back and focus solely on defense.”</p><p>The Hunters heard me and retreated, though they shot me confused glances.</p><p>Understandable.</p><p>No matter how strong I was said to be, I was still a Hunter who had only just reached S-rank. The two S-rank Hunters here could barely hold their own against the boss, let alone deal meaningful damage. So it was only natural they’d be puzzled when the vice president of the Association suddenly stepped forward as if he alone could take down the boss.</p><p>I had no intention of hiding my strength anymore.</p><p>Moreover, since obtaining both gauntlets, I hadn’t properly tested my full power.</p><p>Most enemies died in a single hit, so I had no way to gauge my strength.</p><p>“KIIIIIIEEEEK!”</p><p>The boss monster opened all seven of its mouths and roared at me.</p><p>I sensed victory.</p><p>Beasts exaggerate their actions to avoid fights when they sense their opponent is stronger.</p><p>That thing was scared of me.</p><p>Or maybe it was scared of Nerus, floating in the air where the other Hunters couldn’t see him.</p><p>Didn’t matter.</p><p>I leapt and charged straight at the boss.</p><p>KWADDDDDDRRRK</p><p>“KIIEEK!”</p><p>It spewed fire at me, but I didn’t feel the heat at all.</p><p>It was as if the gauntlets were shielding my entire body.</p><p>I burst through the flames and crushed one of the seven heads. The monster staggered back in shock, as if it couldn’t believe what had happened.</p><p>“Where do you think you’re going.”</p><p>KWAJJJJIK</p><p>I grabbed another head and tore it off.</p><p>“KIIEK!”</p><p>***</p><p>“Huuu…”</p><p>After ripping or crushing all seven heads, the boss monster began thrashing wildly, as if it had lost its mind. But it posed no threat.</p><p>Its heads seemed to regenerate quickly, but once all seven were gone, the regeneration stopped.</p><p>When I gave the Hunters the order to advance, they all charged the boss at once. The pulverized monster fell silent.</p><p>“We… won.”</p><p>“We won!”</p><p>“Fuck yeah! We did it!”</p><p>As the boss fell silent and the escape gate opened on the other side, every Hunter burst into cheers, tears streaming down their faces.</p><p>It was only natural to shed tears of joy after escaping alive from a place where I’d thought I would die.</p><p>As we carried the injured Hunters out of the gate, the Chinese Association members saw us and shouted.</p><p>If we had all died here, Korea-China relations would have taken a serious turn for the worse, and the Korean Association would have suffered a major blow.</p><p>We decided to prioritize transporting the injured Hunters first and discuss the gate later.</p><p>From what the interpreter relayed, it seemed the S-rank gates the Korean Hunters had entered were unusually difficult.</p><p>The Chinese side claimed they had no idea, and the Korean Hunters agreed—since the minor monsters were surprisingly weak for an S-rank gate, they’d assumed the boss monster would be weak as well.</p><p>They promised to mobilize all their resources to treat the injured Hunters with special items.</p><p>-Yes, and it was resolved smoothly. Fortunately, the situation never became dangerous enough for Nerus-nim to step in, so Nerus-nim’s identity wasn’t exposed.</p><p>-That’s a relief… truly a relief! The media will soon report that all the Korean Hunters are safe.</p><p>-Yes, there were seven fatalities, all B-rank Hunters.</p><p>-The Association will handle the families of the deceased… We’ll make sure the funerals are as grand as possible.</p><p>-Understood. Should I return immediately?</p><p>-There are still matters to attend to there. Handle the pending issues as the Association President’s proxy and return at your own pace.</p><p>-Yes, I will.</p><p>I ended the call with Han Ji-hyeok.</p><p>He must have been waiting for my call—he let out a sigh of relief the moment he picked up.</p><p>While the loss of the Hunters was tragic, this incident meant the Korean Association would gain ownership of all special items obtained from the S-rank gate cleared by Korea.</p><p>On top of that, they would receive additional compensation from the Chinese side, so the value was immense.</p><p>“Phew… it’s over.”</p><p>“Seong-hyeon, you’ve worked hard.”</p><p>“No, I couldn’t have fought so aggressively without Nerus-nim there.”</p><p>After exchanging words of gratitude with Nerus, I moved to the hotel prepared by the Chinese side and called my family.</p><p>Everyone was relieved to hear I was safe.</p><p>When I mentioned I’d be staying a few more days, they told me to rest well.</p><p>“Yeah, I’ll just rest…”</p><p>Since all I had to do was sign off on incoming documents, this was far more relaxing than being buried under paperwork back in Korea.</p><p>Nerus returned to Korea through the door first.</p><p>I lay alone in the hotel room, replaying the day’s battle in my mind.</p><p>Vroom—</p><p>That was when it happened.</p><p>A call came from Hye-na.</p><p>—Hello? Hye-na, what’s up?</p><p>—No, where are you right now?</p><p>—I’m resting at the hotel the Chinese side arranged for me. You’re not hurt, right? You’re okay?</p><p>—Me? I barely managed to hold on, but… I’m fine, no injuries.</p><p>—Good, that’s a relief. The Association said we can go back after resting a few days, so let’s return together.</p><p>—Yeah. What are you doing tonight?</p><p>—Probably just lying here. It’s my first real break in a while…</p><p>—Want to drink? I got some Drops.</p><p>—Drops? Where’d you even get those… Never mind, that’s not the point. Are you sure? It hasn’t even been a day since we got out of an S-rank Gate.</p><p>—I took a nap and feel fine now. Can I come to your hotel later tonight?</p><p>—Yeah, I’ll send you the address.</p><p>—See you then.</p><p>—Okay.</p><p>After hanging up with Hye-na, I realized I’d never actually drunk with her before.</p><p>Even though she was the first and only female friend I’d ever had.</p><p>***</p><p>Ding-dong</p><p>The hotel doorbell rang.</p><p>Hye-na had said she’d bring food, so I just stayed sprawled on the bed.</p><p>Squeak</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="291598" loading="lazy">
</p><p>“You here?”</p><p>“Yeah.”</p><p>“Give me the food and sit over there.”</p><p>The plastic bag Hye-na handed me was heavy.</p><p>Inside were over a dozen bottles of Drops.</p><p>“Trying to drink yourself to death tonight?”</p><p>“Now that I think about it, we’ve never actually drunk together before. Let’s make it a long night. Also, I’ve got some questions for you.”</p><p>“Questions? Just ask now.”</p><p>“Nope. I’ll ask after we drink.”</p><p>This is bad.</p><p>She’s probably going to ask about Echo, Nerus, or my gauntlet.</p><p>We set out the food, filled our glasses with Drops, clinked them together, and started drinking in earnest.</p><p>At first, we just talked about old times from the training academy.</p><p>As empty bottles began rolling across the floor and Hye-na’s cheeks flushed red, she finally spoke up.</p><p>“Now I’ll ask my questions.”</p><p>“Hm?”</p><p>A cold sweat broke out on my back.</p>
